contexts.text: The Egyptians represented... the destruction (of the vastated Ancient Church) by their submersion in the sea Suph.
To be submerged in the sea Suph () = that they closed themselves in with falsities from evil.
He must (then) be immersed and submerged in Hell.
He was driven to... Gehenna, that he might be submerged there.
They began to tremble heavily, and to be gradually submerged.
When thou passest through... the rivers, they shall not overwhelm thee () = that reasonings from falsities against truths shall not corrupt. AE 518:33.
Then the waters had overwhelmed us () = falsities, and the consequent destruction of spiritual life which man has through truths and a life according to them.
Deliver me out of the mire lest I sink () = out of the evil of falsity lest I perish.
